what: Scaffold ticket did not gitignore .next/; my own git add -A after next build committed the build cache (11 gitleaks hits, throwaway keys) and I had to filter-branch and force-push the stage branch
rule: Scaffold/gitignore ticket must include .next/, node_modules/, *.tsbuildinfo, next-env.d.ts; integrate should refuse committing build output.
fix: default .gitignore for node stacks in swarm init; go/ship commit step should skip paths that look like build output
